characters.name: Marra Vesk
characters.line: Nobody finds the Post by accident. Mind the lamps.

characters.name: Tolliver Grane
characters.line: Iron by the ingot. I pay in coin, but I would rather be paid in bread.

characters.name: Hesk Dunmoor
characters.line: Seven winters under the fells and I still dream of sky.

characters.name: Ilsa Morrow
characters.line: The mushrooms feed us, but a loaf from above is a feast.

characters.name: Brother Ansel
characters.line: Keep a light and the dark keeps its distance.

characters.name: Wren Pike
characters.line: I know three ways out and only one is on your map.
